narr-title.text: Princess Kathleen and the Five Magic Keys. Chapter Two: The Rainbow Garden.
narr-title.speaker: narrator

narr-intro.text: Princess Kathleen and her fairy friend Pip stepped through the golden door... and into the castle garden. But oh! The garden had turned grey. All the pretty colours had gone.
narr-intro.speaker: narrator

fairy-intro.text: Oh, Princess Kathleen! A little dragon's sneezes blew all the colours away. The flowers look so sad and grey.
fairy-intro.speaker: fairy

fairy-start.text: Look! Colourful butterflies! Catch a butterfly and take it to the flower that matches its colour. That will bring the colours back!
fairy-start.speaker: fairy

fairy-match-red.text: The red flower is blooming again! Beautiful, Kathleen!
fairy-match-red.speaker: fairy

fairy-match-orange.text: Orange! What a lovely sunny colour!
fairy-match-orange.speaker: fairy

fairy-match-yellow.text: Yellow as sunshine! Well done, Kathleen!
fairy-match-yellow.speaker: fairy

fairy-match-green.text: Green is back! The garden is waking up!
fairy-match-green.speaker: fairy

fairy-match-blue.text: Blue as the sky! You're so clever, Kathleen!
fairy-match-blue.speaker: fairy

fairy-wrong-1.text: Oops, not that flower. Let's find the one that matches the butterfly's colour!
fairy-wrong-1.speaker: fairy

fairy-wrong-2.text: Almost! Try a flower the same colour as your butterfly.
fairy-wrong-2.speaker: fairy

fairy-wrong-3.text: Hmm, that butterfly wants a different flower. You can do it!
fairy-wrong-3.speaker: fairy

hint-1.text: Try catching a colourful butterfly, Kathleen!
hint-1.speaker: fairy

hint-2.text: Drag the butterfly to the flower that is the same colour.
hint-2.speaker: fairy

hint-3.text: Look carefully... which flower matches your butterfly?
hint-3.speaker: fairy

narr-burst.text: And then, with a shimmer and a sparkle, the whole garden burst back into colour!
narr-burst.speaker: narrator

fairy-footprints.text: Kathleen, look! Tiny purple footprints... and a magic Rainbow Petal! Let's keep the petal safe.
fairy-footprints.speaker: fairy

narr-complete.text: The little footprints led towards the river. Princess Kathleen and Pip followed them... To be continued!
narr-complete.speaker: narrator
